$schema.description: Lets your editor check this file and suggest fields. Leave it as it is.

id.description: Must match the file name: "sticky-notes" for sticky-notes.json.

name.description: The theme name players see, e.g. "Sticky Notes".

contributors.description: GitHub usernames of the people who made the theme. Add yours.

scheme.description: Whether the theme is light or dark. A theme is always one or the other.

background.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

foreground.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

card.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

card-foreground.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

primary.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

primary-foreground.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

secondary.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

secondary-foreground.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

muted.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

muted-foreground.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

success.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

success-foreground.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

warning.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

warning-foreground.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

destructive.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

destructive-foreground.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

border.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

input.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

ring.description: A color: "#rrggbb", or "oklch(lightness chroma hue)" with lightness 0–1, chroma 0–0.5, hue 0–360.

colors.description: Every color token. Each "-foreground" color is for text on the color it is named after.

fonts.description: The font for text, and the font for headings and the big words on cards.

body.description: A font from the list in src/sdk/theme/fonts.ts.

heading.description: A font from the list in src/sdk/theme/fonts.ts.

radius.description: Corner rounding in rem: 0 is square, 2 is very round.

shadow.description: Shadows under cards and buttons: none, soft, or bold and sharp.

gradient.description: Fades the page background from one color token to another, top to bottom. Leave out for a plain background.

duration.description: How long animations take, in milliseconds.

parts.description: Looks to pick from a menu (ADR 0011). Leave out any you don't want; each defaults to the plain look.

decoration.description: Small drawings on the flash card and dialogs.
